<?php
/*
 * Sol y Sól – wstawki na stronie głównej (pasek PILNE, magazyn w ciemnej ramce,
 * kafel „Czy wiesz, że…”, sekcja „Zagadki Costa del Sol”).
 * Wyłączenie: usuń ten plik z wp-content/mu-plugins.
 */
if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) { exit; }

function sys_wst_dir() {
	$u = wp_upload_dir();
	return array( $u['basedir'] . '/sys-wstawki', $u['baseurl'] . '/sys-wstawki' );
}

/* Jednorazowo: zapis plików (czcionka, naklejki) do uploads + tag „pilne” na wpisie o 10% IVA. */
add_action( 'init', function () {
	if ( get_option( 'sys_wst_v' ) === '4' ) { return; }
	if ( in_array( get_option( 'sys_wst_v' ), array( '1', '2', '3' ), true ) ) { do_action( 'litespeed_purge_all' ); update_option( 'sys_wst_v', '4', false ); return; }
	list( $dir ) = sys_wst_dir();
	wp_mkdir_p( $dir );
	$files = array(
		'anton-latin.woff2' => '',
		'anton-latin-ext.woff2' => '',
		'malpa.webp' => '',
		'cytryna.webp' => '',
	);
	foreach ( $files as $n => $d ) { file_put_contents( $dir . '/' . $n, base64_decode( $d ) ); }
	$q = new WP_Query( array( 's' => '10% IVA', 'posts_per_page' => 1, 'post_status' => 'publish' ) );
	if ( $q->have_posts() ) { wp_set_post_tags( $q->posts[0]->ID, array( 'pilne' ), true ); }
	do_action( 'litespeed_purge_all' );
	update_option( 'sys_wst_v', '4', false );
} );

function sys_wst_pilne() {
	$q = new WP_Query( array(
		'tag' => 'pilne', 'posts_per_page' => 1, 'post_status' => 'publish', 'no_found_rows' => true,
		'date_query' => array( array( 'after' => '10 days ago' ) ),
	) );
	if ( ! $q->have_posts() ) { return ''; }
	$p = $q->posts[0];
	return '<div class="wst-pil"><div class="wrap wst-pil-in"><b>PILNE</b><a href="' . esc_url( get_permalink( $p ) ) . '">' . esc_html( get_the_title( $p ) ) . '</a><span class="wst-pil-r">Wiadomości z wybrzeża codziennie o 8:00 i 19:00</span></div></div>';
}

function sys_wst_czywiesz() {
	list( , $url ) = sys_wst_dir();
	return '<a class="wst-cw" href="https://www.instagram.com/solysol.pl/" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="wst-sun"></span><img src="' . esc_url( $url . '/malpa.webp' ) . '" alt="" width="150" height="140" loading="lazy"><span class="wst-k">Czy wiesz, że…</span><span class="wst-cw-t">Małpy i rozkaz Churchilla</span><span class="wst-cw-l">Legenda kontra fakty →</span></a>';
}

function sys_wst_zagadki() {
	$e = array(
		array( 'KdNss3blGvI', 'James Bond kontra Marbella' ),
		array( 'hlRCkZhjwWU', 'Afera Malaya' ),
		array( 'iFhqOZl4kbY', 'Książę Marbelli' ),
		array( 'Y6F7ePx80b8', 'Costa del Crime' ),
	);
	$h = '';
	foreach ( $e as $i => $x ) {
		$h .= '<a class="wst-z" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' . $x[0] . '" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="https://i.ytimg.com/vi/' . $x[0] . '/maxresdefault.jpg" alt="' . esc_attr( $x[1] ) . '" loading="lazy" width="640" height="360"><span class="wst-k">Odc. ' . ( $i + 1 ) . '</span><span class="wst-z-t">' . esc_html( $x[1] ) . '</span></a>';
	}
	return '<section class="wst-zag"><div class="wrap"><div class="wst-zh"><h2>Zagadki <i>Costa del Sol</i></h2><span class="wst-stamp">TAJNE</span><a href="https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPBIudLpycyg6tsZh-dS2UQ" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Niedziela, 18:00 · YouTube →</a></div><div class="wst-zg">' . $h . '</div></div></section>';
}

function sys_wst_css() {
	list( , $url ) = sys_wst_dir();
	return '<style id="sys-wstawki">
@font-face{font-family:"Anton";font-display:swap;src:url(' . $url . '/anton-latin.woff2) format("woff2");unicode-range:U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+02BB-02BC,U+02C6,U+02DA,U+02DC,U+2000-206F,U+2074,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2191,U+2193,U+2212,U+2215,U+FEFF,U+FFFD}
@font-face{font-family:"Anton";font-display:swap;src:url(' . $url . '/anton-latin-ext.woff2) format("woff2");unicode-range:U+0100-02AF,U+0304,U+0308,U+0329,U+1E00-1E9F,U+1EF2-1EFF,U+2020,U+20A0-20AB,U+20AD-20C0,U+2113,U+2C60-2C7F,U+A720-A7FF}
.wst-k{display:block;font:700 11px/1.2 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9622B}
.wst-sun,.ew-cover::before{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#D8622B 36%,transparent 40%) 0 0/9px 9px,radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#F08A4B,#B8401C)}
/* PILNE */
.wst-pil{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid #e6dfd2}
.wst-pil-in{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding-top:10px;padding-bottom:10px;font:500 14px/1.3 Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}
.wst-pil b{background:#F2C94C;color:#1E1C19;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;padding:4px 9px;font-weight:800}
.wst-pil a{color:#1E1C19;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}.wst-pil a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.wst-pil-r{margin-left:auto;color:#7a7266;font-weight:400;font-size:13px}
/* MAGAZYN */
section.ew{background:#2F2C27!important;color:#F2ECE0}
section.ew .ew-cover{position:relative;display:block}
section.ew .ew-cover::before{content:"";width:118%;aspect-ratio:1;left:-34%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:0}
section.ew .ew-cover img{position:relative;z-index:1;transform:rotate(-3deg);box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
section.ew .ew-cover::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:2;right:-38px;bottom:-14px;width:90px;height:100px;background:url(' . $url . '/cytryna.webp) center/contain no-repeat;transform:rotate(-10deg);filter:drop-shadow(3px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
section.ew .ew-k{color:#D9622B!important}
section.ew h2{color:#F2ECE0!important;font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,66px)!important;line-height:1.04!important}
section.ew h2 i{color:#F2ECE0;background:linear-gradient(transparent 60%,#D9622B 60%,#D9622B 90%,transparent 90%)}
section.ew p{color:#BFB6A7!important}
section.ew .ew-btn{background:#D9622B!important;color:#fff!important;border-color:#D9622B!important}
section.ew .ew-lnk{color:#BFB6A7!important}
/* CZY WIESZ */
.wst-cw{position:relative;display:block;overflow:hidden;background:#2F2C27;color:#F2ECE0;text-decoration:none;padding:30px 34px;margin:0 0 28px;min-height:170px}
.wst-cw .wst-sun{width:230px;height:230px;right:-30px;top:-30px}
.wst-cw img{position:absolute;right:40px;bottom:6px;width:130px;height:auto;transform:rotate(6deg);filter:drop-shadow(3px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.3))}
.wst-cw .wst-k{color:#F2C94C;position:relative}
.wst-cw-t{position:relative;display:block;font:400 46px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;margin:10px 0 10px;max-width:60%}
.wst-cw-l{position:relative;font:400 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;color:#BFB6A7}
.wst-cw:hover .wst-cw-l{color:#fff}
/* ZAGADKI */
.wst-zag{background:#2F2C27;color:#F2ECE0;padding:56px 0 60px;margin:40px 0}
.wst-zh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:26px;margin-bottom:26px}
.wst-zh h2{font:600 44px/1.1 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;color:#F2ECE0;margin:0}
.wst-zh h2 i{font-style:italic}
.wst-stamp{border:3px solid #D2452F;color:#D2452F;font:400 26px/1 Anton,Impact,sans-serif;padding:5px 14px 3px;transform:rotate(-8deg);letter-spacing:.06em}
.wst-zh a{margin-left:auto;font:700 12px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#D9622B;text-decoration:none}
.wst-zg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:22px}
.wst-z{color:#F2ECE0;text-decoration:none}
.wst-z img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9;object-fit:cover;margin-bottom:12px;transition:transform .2s}
.wst-z:hover img{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.wst-z-t{display:block;font:600 23px/1.15 "Cormorant Garamond",Georgia,serif;margin-top:4px}
@media(max-width:900px){.wst-zg{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.wst-pil-r{display:none}.wst-cw-t{font-size:34px;max-width:70%}.wst-zh{flex-wrap:wrap}.wst-zh a{margin-left:0;width:100%}}
@media(max-width:560px){.wst-zg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.wst-cw img{width:96px;right:12px}section.ew .ew-cover::after{display:none}}
</style>';
}

function sys_wst_logo_css() {
	return '<style id="sys-wst-logo">.wm .wst-sun-o{display:inline-block;width:.78em;height:.78em;border-radius:50%;vertical-align:-.04em;margin:0 .03em;background:radial-gradient(circle,#D8622B 36%,transparent 40%) 0 0/.12em .12em,radial-gradient(circle at 40% 35%,#F08A4B,#B8401C)}.wst-soc-t{display:inline-flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-left:16px;padding-left:16px;border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)}.wst-soc-t .wst-soc-a{display:inline-flex;color:inherit;opacity:.85}.wst-soc-t .wst-soc-a:hover{opacity:1;color:#F08A4B}.wst-soc-f{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:22px 0;margin:10px 0 6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(127,127,127,.25);font:500 14px Inter,system-ui,sans-serif}.wst-soc-f b{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:12px;color:#D9622B}.wst-soc-f .wst-soc-a{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.wst-soc-f .wst-soc-a:hover{color:#D9622B}.wm .wst-y{font-style:italic;text-transform:none;color:#D9622B;letter-spacing:0;margin:0 .3em 0 .26em;font-size:.82em}</style>';
}

add_action( 'template_redirect', function () {
	if ( is_admin() || wp_doing_ajax() || is_feed() ) { return; }
	$front = is_front_page();
	ob_start( function ( $html ) use ( $front ) {
		if ( strpos( $html, 'sys-wst-logo' ) !== false || strpos( $html, '</html>' ) === false ) { return $html; }
		$html = str_replace( 'SOL Y S<span class="o">', 'S<span class="wst-sun-o"></span>L<span class="wst-y">y</span>S<span class="o">', $html );
		$html = preg_replace( '#(<div class="tr">.*?)(</div>)#s', '$1' . sys_wst_social( 'wst-soc-t' ) . '$2', $html, 1 );
		$html = preg_replace( '#<div class="legal">#', sys_wst_social( 'wst-soc-f' ) . '<div class="legal">', $html, 1 );
		$css  = sys_wst_logo_css() . ( $front ? sys_wst_css() : '' );
		$html = preg_replace( '#</head>#', $css . '</head>', $html, 1 );
		if ( ! $front ) { return $html; }
		$p = strpos( $html, '</header>' );
		if ( $p !== false ) { $html = substr_replace( $html, '</header>' . sys_wst_pilne(), $p, 9 ); }
		$html = preg_replace( '#(<section class="curios">\s*<div class="wrap">\s*<div class="sechead">.*?</div>)#s', '$1' . sys_wst_czywiesz(), $html, 1 );
		$html = preg_replace( '#<section class="brief"#', sys_wst_zagadki() . '<section class="brief"', $html, 1 );
		return $html;
	} );
} );
